metadata.title: Anthropic’s ‘Adjusted’ Profit Exposes Wall Street’s Earnings Game - WSJ

content.text:
There’s a flip side to Anthropic’s $80.7 billion net loss for the first half of this year. On the other side of the ledger, Amazon.com AMZN 0.44%increase; up pointing triangle and Alphabet GOOGL -1.06%decrease; down pointing triangle booked large paper gains on some of the same financing deals.
This tees up a vexing question as Anthropic prepares for an initial public offering as soon as November: Should gains and losses like those count in the alternative earnings metrics widely touted by Wall Street stock analysts?
